outputs.explanation: Both the body weight plot and the LW/BW & FW/BW plot show mean/SD bars with individual data points (dots for NC, squares for HFD) overlaid for each mouse.
Panel B is a photograph, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel C consists of micrograph images, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel D is a dot blot and methylene blue staining image, not a plot showing averaged data.
The bar chart quantifying 5mC/methylene blue ratio shows individual data points (circles for NC, squares for HFD) overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.

The bottom bar chart quantifying TET1/2/3 over GAPDH ratios shows individual data points (circles and squares) overlaid on the mean ± SEM bars for each protein and condition; the blot itself is not a summary plot.
